title: an office cabinet obstruction

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: My desk drawer is stuck halfway open.
turns.zh: 我書桌的抽屜卡在半開的位置。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: A. A folder is sticking out. B. The handles were replaced. C. I copied the forms yesterday.
turns.zh: A. 有個資料夾凸在外面。 B. 把手換過了。 C. 我昨天影印了那些表單。
